iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

POP3::enable
       Enable POP3 (STARTTLS for POP3).

SYNOPSIS
       POP3::enable

DESCRIPTION
       Enable POP3 (STARTTLS for POP3)

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
	when CLIENT_ACCEPTED {
	    if { ([IP::addr [IP::client_addr] equals 10.0.0.0/8]) } {
		POP3::enable
	    }
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-13.1.0 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
